purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official state cadastral-map service and local revenue/survey offices are identified. The AP Bhunaksha web shell timed out along this network path before map metadata or a target village could be inspected. No point-level parcel coverage or full geometry is verified.
registryAssessment: The official East Godavari district directory lists the Rajahmundry Urban Tahsildar, and the Telugu district page describes the mandal surveyor role in land survey and records. The Andhra Pradesh Bhunaksha site is an official public-facing cadastral mapping system integrated with land-record services. This confirms local land-record administration, but no anonymous full parcel geometry was verified.
